name: Scento Perfume Compendium
description: Free perfume knowledge app: 1,600+ designer and niche perfumes, 400+ raw materials and Scento's fragrance families, every answer linked to a page on scento.com.
content: Scento Perfume Compendium answers fragrance questions inside ChatGPT. Look up a perfume, a house, a note or an ingredient, compare perfumes, find similar scents and browse by fragrance family or occasion. No account or API key. Developer docs: https://www.scento.com/developers
